[EN] Black Tidings
[ES] Noticias sombrías
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] When you find them, kill a few for me!
[ES] ¡Cuando los encuentres, mata a unos cuantos por mí!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We barely saved a handful of them...
[ES] Apenas salvamos a un puñado de ellos...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You too, Casias!"
[ES] "¡Tú también, Casias!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Casias near the cave leading to Nightwood.
[ES] Encuentra a Casias cerca de la cueva que lleva a Nightwood.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "On it!"
[ES] "¡En eso estoy!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Warn Denmar about the source of the undead.
[ES] Advierte a Denmar sobre el origen de los no-muertos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Stamp out the mekonaris and their undead minions on the eastern road.
[ES] Extermina a los mekonaris y a sus esbirros no-muertos en el camino oriental.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "You did all you could."
[ES] "Hiciste todo lo que pudiste."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Denmar.
[ES] Regresa con Denmar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
